value.title: Private local resource probes never alter rendering or data admission
value.statement: privateResourceProfiling is false by default and incompatible with the verification APK. Detailed local work accounting is independent of legacy cap16/throttle and preserves aggregate request/outcome/count/phase totals when bounded raw records are rejected. Wall and same-TID CPU differ; cross-thread CPU is unknown. SDK durations are not GPU time; SDK memory counters are distinct from process PSS and aggregate/subcategory counters must not be summed. No coordinate/URI/business attributes/rendered-feature lists, forced GC, wake lock or native ownership inferred from process memory deltas. Resource failure/stop never cancels rendering. Native/CPU traces have explicit coverage/loss/PID/source identity and owned-process stop guards. Profileable is added only to a private signed copy; no publication/Full admission is implied.
